description: Section 3 — Dashboard, funnel analytics, and custom-range reporting. Add two pipeline funnel diagrams (Purchase funnel and Sales funnel) to the dashboard and a flexible custom-range report that can be filtered by date range / month / customer / supplier / per PO number. Depends on FEAT-002 because the funnel stages and reconciliation status come from the pipeline data.
steps: In public/classic/modules/dashboard.js, add a PURCHASE FUNNEL visualization with the stages: Open PO Supplier -> Surat Jalan / Truk Jalan -> Tiba/Timbang -> Reconciled -> Invoiced Supplier. Derive each stage count from window.DB (purchaseOrders by status, deliveryOrders/goodsReceipts, weighed records, reconciled flag from FEAT-002, purchaseInvoices). Use the existing Chart.js integration (window.Chart) already used in dashboard.js, or a clean HTML/CSS funnel if a chart type does not fit; match the existing card styling.

Add a SALES FUNNEL with stages: Open PO Customer (SO) -> Pengambilan Bertahap (staged pickups / DOs) -> Draft Invoice -> Invoiced -> Paid. Derive counts from salesOrders, deliveryOrders, salesInvoices (Draft vs Outstanding vs Paid), salesReceipts.

Add a CUSTOM-RANGE REPORT view. Reuse report-extras.js / financial-reports.js patterns. Provide filters: date range (from/to), month shortcut, customer, supplier, and PO number. Output a filterable table of matching transactions with totals. Register the view in nav.js MENU_CONFIG (Reports group) and menu-router.js ROUTES.
If a new classic file is added, register it in vite.config.js classicAll (before rbac.js). If extending dashboard.js/report-extras.js in place, no vite change needed.
Ensure the funnels and report degrade gracefully with empty DB (no crash, show 'Belum ada data').

Add Vitest coverage tests/funnel-report.test.ts: build a window.DB with a few PO/SO/DO/receipt/invoice records and assert the funnel-stage counting function returns the correct counts per stage, and that the custom-range filter correctly includes/excludes by date range, customer, supplier, and PO number. Follow the classic-module import pattern. Expose the pure counting/filter helpers on the module's window.* object so they are unit-testable.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard renders a Purchase funnel with the five named stages and a Sales funnel with the five named stages, counts derived from DB.
A custom-range report view exists, reachable from the Reports menu, filterable by date range, month, customer, supplier, and PO number, showing matching transactions and totals.
Funnels/report do not throw on empty data.
`npm run test:run` passes including funnel/report tests that would fail if the stage-counting or filter logic were reverted.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED Section 3: pipeline funnel analytics on the dashboard + a flexible custom-range report.

WHAT CHANGED (files):
1. public/classic/core/funnel-report.js (NEW classic IIFE, window._funnelReport):
   - PURE HELPERS (unit-testable, no DOM): purchaseFunnel(db) -> 5 ordered stages {key,label,count} using the EXACT handoff labels: Open PO Supplier -> Surat Jalan / Truk Jalan -> Tiba/Timbang -> Reconciled -> Invoiced Supplier. Counts derived from DB: open POs (status !== Received && !== Cancelled), receipts with a surat-jalan line + purchase-side DOs, receipts with weighing.netQty > 0 (Tiba/Timbang), receipts with reconciled===true (FEAT-002 flag), purchaseInvoices (fallback: receipts.invoiced).
   - salesFunnel(db) -> 5 stages: Open PO Customer (SO status !== Delivered) -> Pengambilan Bertahap (sales-side DOs) -> Draft Invoice (salesInvoices Draft) -> Invoiced (Outstanding) -> Paid (salesInvoices Paid, fallback salesReceipts).
   - filterTransactions(db, filters) -> { rows, totals:{purchase,sales,count} }, filterable by from/to date range (inclusive), month shortcut (YYYY-MM, overrides range), customer (case-insensitive substring, excludes purchases), supplier (excludes sales), po (number/id substring), and kind. Pure + tested.
   - renderPurchaseFunnelHtml / renderSalesFunnelHtml: HTML/CSS horizontal funnel bars (no Chart.js funnel type exists) matching the dashboard widget-card styling; show 'Belum ada data' when all counts are 0.
   - openCustomRange(): report view rendered into view-reports (same injectView pattern as report-extras.js), with a filter form (date range, month, jenis, customer/supplier dropdowns, PO number) + result table with per-kind totals; Terapkan repaints only #cr-result, Reset clears. Degrades to 'Belum ada data yang cocok' on empty match.
2. public/classic/core/funnel-report.d.ts (NEW): // Stub export {} so tsc resolves the test's dynamic import (same convention as pipeline-extras.d.ts / cost-ledger.d.ts).
3. public/classic/modules/dashboard.js: added two widgets 'purchaseFunnel' and 'salesFunnel' to DASH_WIDGET_CATALOG + _wdef; their inner HTML comes from window._funnelReport (guarded fallback to a 'Belum ada data' card if the module is absent). funnel-report.js loads before dashboard.js in the bundle so the global is ready.
4. vite.config.js: added 'public/classic/core/funnel-report.js' to classicAll right after report-extras.js (and before menu-router.js/rbac.js/lazy-views.js).
5. public/classic/core/menu-router.js: added ROUTE 'Laporan Custom Range' -> ['_funnelReport','openCustomRange'].
6. public/classic/ui/nav.js: added Reports MENU_CONFIG item { icon:'sliders', label:'Laporan Custom Range', view:'reports' } (sliders icon exists in _menuIcon).
7. tests/funnel-report.test.ts (NEW): 11 tests. Assert the 5 purchase + 5 sales stage labels/order, per-stage counts from a seeded PO/SO/DO/receipt/invoice DB (would FAIL if counting logic reverted, e.g. Open PO = 2 excludes Received+Cancelled, Tiba/Timbang = 1 only netQty>0), empty-DB degradation (all zero, no throw), and custom-range filter include/exclude by date range, month, customer, supplier, and PO number.

NO new collections; funnels read existing goodsReceipts (weighing/reconciled), purchaseOrders/salesOrders, deliveryOrders, purchase/salesInvoices, salesReceipts. No rbac change needed (reports view already gated).

VERIFICATION (all green): npm run test:run = 20 files / 249 tests pass (238 baseline + 11 new). npm run type-check = exactly the 12 pre-existing baseline errors (rbac.test.ts x11 + twofa-flow.test.ts x1), ZERO new. npm run lint = clean (0 rule violations; only the harmless .eslintignore deprecation warning; test file prettier-formatted). npm run build = success, dist/classic/bundle.js emitted (731.66 kB). NOTE: package-lock.json shows modified in git but that predates this feature (session-start npm install, documented in FEAT-002) - not touched here.
